### Counter-proofs
- Closest alternatives: (i) the closed job 13b3e213 - excluded by "the mold job awaiting clearance"; (ii) the company recording the final supplement on delivery - retired base rule 7 and the hub: "for a final mold supplement this policy prices on a Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support file, and only for such a supplement, ... the insured submits it"; (iii) base labor on a multifamily unit "as billed" - displaced by the attic labor rule "whatever the property"; (iv) protocol figure unheld (2462.44) - "the protocol figure may not exceed it".
- "Do only the one thing": the final figure now = 4186.24 held to 2457.15 -> 2457.15; excluded by the hub sentence and by the records (no protocol supplement on file).
- Open points: (i) ordinance_law_limit recorded 0.00 is read as "carries no ordinance-or-law limit" - the factor text speaks of a file that "carries" a limit, the record has 0.00; not closed by any visible definition (observation). (ii) Whether a location factor's tier replaces or adds to the base family of the same name (surface, removal, air, labor): read as replacing, because each factor doc names the family it sets ("the surface treatment is taken as follows", "the removal is taken as follows", "the air treatment is taken as follows", "The labor is taken as follows") and an additive reading would count the same billed lines twice (dehumidifier days, insulation removal); flagged for the reveal.
